name: Unni
title: Levitical musician in the temple
summary: Unni was a Levite who served as a musician in the temple service after returning from the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned among the Levites who participated in worship in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time and played a role in restoring orderly worship in the rebuilt temple.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the Levites in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Unni is mentioned among the Levites who settled in Jerusalem after returning from exile and took part in the temple service.

keyEvents.title: Participation in musical service
keyEvents.description: Unni was among the Levites appointed to play musical instruments in connection with the transfer of the ark of God's covenant, as described in Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Service with harps
keyEvents.description: Unni was appointed to play the harp along with other Levites in the orderly worship organized by King David.

keyEvents.title: Levitical lineage in Nehemiah's time
keyEvents.description: A Unni (or Unno) is also mentioned among the Levites who served during Nehemiah's governorship, showing that this name was known among the Levites in the post-exilic period.
